mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and corporate input costs, leading to reduced profit margins and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the average 20d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 2.0% over a 3-month window signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the mean 20d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals strong aggregate demand growth that supports corporate revenues and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term in a regression model has a non-positive coefficient (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate output and signals deteriorating economic momentum, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances, or the average 60d return in such periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in real personal consumption (RSAFS) above its 12-month moving average combined with a concurrent rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals robust consumer and investment demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to generate positive 5d returns in > 60% of cases, or the joint effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) exceeding 200k in a single month, combined with a declining unemployment rate, indicates strong labor market momentum that boosts consumer spending and supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 200k and UNRATE declines > 0.2pp in 1 month
failure_condition: The joint signal of high PAYEMS growth and falling UNRATE fails to produce positive 20d returns in > 60% of cases, or the interaction term is not positive and significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% year-over-year, combined with a low federal funds rate, signals inflationary pressures that may trigger future rate hikes, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction signal fails to predict negative 60d returns in > 60% of cases, or the coefficient on the interaction term is not negative and significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) at a quarterly rate above 3.0% signals strong economic momentum that supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 3.0% q/q, or the average 60d return in such periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).
